content: Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this medication and your specific health needs. To achieve the best results, take this antibiotic at evenly spaced intervals. For weekly schedules, take it on the same day and time each week. Continue taking this medication, along with other tuberculosis (TB) medications, for the full prescribed duration, even if your symptoms improve before completing the course. Possible Side Effects: Nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, or mild muscle and joint pain may occur. Remember, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not an exhaustive list of side effects. In the United States or Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Precautions: Before using pyrazinamide, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Avoid alcohol, as it may increase the risk of liver disease. Pyrazinamide may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is known to pass into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain lab tests, such as urine ketone tests, potentially causing false results. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms like passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Monitoring: While taking this medication, lab and medical tests (e.g., sputum tests, kidney and liver function tests, uric acid levels, complete blood counts) should be conducted regularly. Keep all medical and lab appointments. Missed Dose: It is crucial to take each dose as scheduled. If you miss a daily dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. For weekly schedules, take the missed dose as soon as you remember. If you remember a day or more later, consult your doctor or pharmacist for a new dosing schedule. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This summary does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
